messages:
oncall-bot: SEV-2 alert: multiple hosted runtime pods reporting KV_CACHE OOMs (node=hosted-infer-prod-8). Metric spike at 2468102467. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

alex.nguyen: I see the surge in prefetch + continuous-batching count. KV cache memory jumped from ~12GB to 48GB across pods. Suspect runaway context amplification from long prompts + aggressive prefetch window.

samira: confirming logs, tails: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:02Z] kvcache: prefetch_window=4096, num_prefetch_tasks=620
[2026-03-15T12:07:05Z] mem: used=48.2GB limit=48GB -> OOM
[2026-03-15T12:07:06Z] runtime: continuous_batcher: inflight_batches=18, avg_tokens_per_batch=1240
```

dave.k: paging oncall. I'm switching to pager duty. Oncall here. first step: throttle prefetch + pause continuous batching for hosted runtime.

jess-ops: agree. Running hotfix patch now: set PREFETCH_BATCH_LIMIT=64 and PREFETCH_WINDOW_MAX=1024, and turn off CONTINUOUS_BATCHING for the hosted pool.

leah-prod: note: customer impact - 2 high-volume tenants showing 500s and dsr-ing. Lower tiers experiencing elevated latency but not errors. We should prepare a customer-facing note.

alex.nguyen: commands I ran in debug pod (for reference):
```
kubectl -n hosted-infer-prod exec -it runtime-debug -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s http://localhost:8080/metrics | grep kvcache"
# then
kubectl -n hosted-infer-prod set env ds=serving PREFETCH_WINDOW_MAX=1024 PREFETCH_BATCH_LIMIT=64
kubectl -n hosted-infer-prod rollout restart deploy/runtime-pool-hosted
```

samira: deploy bot: @deploy-bot initiated canary: runtime/hosted-pool patch -> env update PREFETCH_WINDOW_MAX=1024 PREFETCH_BATCH_LIMIT=64. Canary on 2 pods. Continuous batching disabled via runtime flag.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: runtime/hosted-pool -> pods (hosted-03, hosted-09). Observing metrics for 5m.

alex.nguyen: immediate mitigation results: OOMs stopped on canary pods, kvcache usage down to ~9GB after restart. Inflight batches reduced, latency improves.

jess-ops: rolling the env change to the rest of the pool now with 30s stagger. We'll keep continuous batching off until we tune batching window heuristics.

leah-prod: tagging impacted customers: tenant-psi-2 and tenant-orbit. psi-2 saw ~18% error elevation for 12m, orbit saw timeouts on long-context queries. Support: please draft update.

support-bot: Noted. Drafting status page: "We are investigating increased latency and errors for hosted inference customers due to a KV cache memory spike triggered by long-context prompts. A mitigation is being rolled out." Will post after ops confirmation.

alex.nguyen: root cause hypothesis: "context amplification" - certain user prompts chain generate prefixes that cause prefetch to materialize very large KV entries repeatedly; combined with an overly permissive prefetch_window_limit + continuous batching that groups extremely long contexts into big batches. That combination created an allocation blowup.

dave.k: action items:
- short-term: keep PREFETCH_WINDOW_MAX=1024, PREFETCH_BATCH_LIMIT=64, CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false for hosted pool (in effect).
- mid-term (48h): add adaptive prefetch backpressure: limit num_prefetch_tasks per session, add TTL eviction for large prefixes, and cap kv entry size enforced in runtime.
- long-term: add per-tenant alarm for kvcache growth and a safe-mode auto-throttle.

jess-ops: filing a postmortem ticket now: PM-INC-24681. Assigning to samira (investigation) and alex.nguyen (runtime fixes).

samira: collecting artifact logs + trace spans for the affected time window; will attach replay of the offending request sequences. Also we should surface failing prompt examples (sanitized) for model/ux teams.

leah-prod: customer comms: draft ready. support-bot to send to tenant contacts after we validate that error rates returned to baseline (monitor stable for 10m).

support-bot: Prepared msg -> "We're sorry for the disruption. We've deployed a mitigation that reduces excessive memory usage for long-context requests. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with a root cause update." Ready to send on confirmation.

alex.nguyen: monitoring: no new OOMs in last 6 minutes across pool; average kvcache mem back to 8-11GB; inflight_batch avg token count down 4x. I'll keep watching for 30m then flip continuous batching to a tuned mode (adaptive).

dave.k: oncall handoff: I'll be primary until next shift. Notifying next oncall with summary. If error rates rise again escalate to SEV1.

oncall-bot: Handoff: dave.k is now oncall primary for this incident. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

jess-ops: final note: repinned hosted runtime image to hotpatch build id 2026.3.15-hf1 with prefetch safety checks. Please don't revert env flags until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
